metadata.title: Resume — Olivier Rasolomanana
metadata.description: Experience, judgment, and technical range Olivier Rasolomanana brings to teams turning product ideas into usable software.

title: Experience shaped by delivery.
intro: A concise view of the work, judgment, and technical range I bring to teams turning product ideas into usable software.

achievements: Building four live products for founders: Gando (fintech), Cléo Network (real-estate marketplace), Kididraw (edtech) and Mallow (iOS booking app).
Own each product end to end: scope, data model, web and mobile apps, payments and launch.
Work on Next.js, React Native (Expo), Supabase and Stripe, with AI coding agents in the loop and the critical rules kept in my hands.
Designed and built a cross-platform Flutter app for discovering nearby restaurants and booking online.
Built the restaurant management platform: profiles, reservations and loyalty cards.
Delivered an internal admin app for the Fedhubs team using a low-code tool.
Built a web app to improve the online visibility of restaurants in Paris.
Delivered responsive interfaces and small product features with React, Next.js and Laravel.
Built Prompt AI, a platform to share and discover prompts for AI content generation (Next.js, MongoDB).

foundation.title: Learning that stays practical.
education: Licence in software engineering and databases — École Nationale d'Informatique (ENI), 2023 — 2025.
Finalist, ENI algorithm competition (2022) and ENI internal hackathon (2023).
